description: Creates a playlist in the calling account's notebook. Playlists are flat and allow multi-membership: a song can be in several of them. `songIds` is the ordered content and every id must be a live song of this account. Consumes one unit of the daily write quota.

coverEmoji.description: Single emoji used as the cover, or null for none.

name.description: Playlist name as the user will see it.

songIds.description: Ordered content of the playlist; the order is what the user will see and is never re-sorted. Every id must be a live song of this account, otherwise the whole call fails: a half-created playlist would be worse than a refusal.

name: jj_create_playlist
title: Create a notebook playlist
